title: Old Rinkrank

full_text:
A king built a sheer Mountain of Glass and announced that whoever could run up to the summit without falling should marry his daughter. The princess herself rode up the slippery glass on a specially shod horse alongside her favorite suitor. But halfway up, the horse slipped, the mountain cracked open, and the princess plummeted into a deep subterranean cavern.

She found herself imprisoned by an ancient dwarf named Old Rinkrank, who possessed a silver beard so long it dragged across the floor. Rinkrank forced her to cook, wash, and clean his underground palace, while he used an enchanted silver ladder every morning to climb out into the upper world to gather gold.

For years, the princess plotted her escape. One evening, when Rinkrank returned and asked her to wash his long silver beard, she led him to the window and deliberately shut the heavy oak casement onto his beard, pinning him fast to the sill!

Rinkrank screamed and struggled, but the princess refused to release him until he revealed the secret words that opened the mountain and showed her where his ladder was hidden.

Climbing up to the sunlight, she opened the cavern gates, reunited with her joyful prince, and brought down the mountain's riches, while Old Rinkrank was left pinned to his window until he promised never to trap mortals again.
moral: A clever and courageous spirit finds a way out of the deepest underground prisons.

quiz.question: What is the central moral lesson taught in "Old Rinkrank"?
options: Presence of mind and quiet wisdom triumph over brute strength.
Acting in haste and anger without thinking
Believing rumors and flattery without proof
quiz.hint: Remember the moral lesson of this traditional story.

quiz.question: How do the characters overcome their challenge?
options: Through patience, calm reflection, and wisdom
By shouting loudly and blaming others
By running away from every problem
quiz.hint: Consider the virtues praised in world folklore.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
options: Honesty, kindness, and clear thinking lead to peace
quiz.hint: Reflect upon the resolution of the story.

vocabulary.meaning: wise advice given to guide decisions
the ability to judge well and understand the truth
